_about: retro.vibes.arcade: PS2-era graphics. What the GPU job (studio/retro_gen.py, run on Kaggle) is asked to make: mostly empty early-2000s game levels and pre-rendered cutscene CGI. Every scene is our own idea: no real games, characters, consoles' menus or boot screens, brands, logos or people, so nothing in a clip belongs to anyone else; 'PS2 era' only names the style. A clip is one scene + one look + a seed; the renderer (studio/retro_video.py) cuts them to the song. Rewritten 2026-11-24 from the first 46 clips: the camera move comes first in every scene (Wan 1.3B otherwise makes near-stills); the 'ps2' look no longer asks for low-res, jagged or 480i (the model drew melted mush; the renderer adds the 480i itself); new themes are familiar places with one impossible detail (what liminal and dreamcore pages are built on) and glossy aqua Y2K worlds; the abstract menu backgrounds are dropped (nobody picks a menu to live in).

subjects._about: ascii.terminal.dreams, not retro.vibes.arcade: one bold living subject that fills a tall frame, richly lit, on a dark ground, to be set in letters by studio/asciiviz/letters.py (scene wild). Our own ideas: no real people, characters, brands or logos. Clips are recorded under theme 'subject-<name>' and never used by the retro account.
